notes: Tail case; all units rewritten. U1 recolour of an already-white ship was a no-op and the mask included the '18 MOORING' boards: now the hull only (SAM3 'ship hull', boards excluded) recoloured dark navy blue. U2 bare-colour replace -> structural streetlight replace. U3 mask was a distant glass tower, not a sign: retargeted to the single-lantern lamp post beside the ship's stern. U4 railing panel mask refined to the metal railing (water through the gaps excluded); payload/relation made concrete.
